Name: Shammai, Son of Onam
Summary: Son of Onam and father of Nadab and Abishur.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:28: Son of Onam and father of Nadab and Abishur.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shammai stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
